postings.title: Chief of Staff
postings.description:
Chief of Staff
Contract type: Permanent
Location: Hatfield (Hybrid working - 3 days in the office)
Working hours per week: 40 hours
Level: Lead
Application Closing Date: Friday 27th November 2026

About us
Our mission is to deliver joy in every shop, through unbeatable choice, unrivalled service, and reassuringly good value.
We’re Ocado Retail, a market-leading joint venture between Ocado Group and M&S, and the world’s largest dedicated online supermarket, ocado.com. Not only is Ocado.com the only place to shop a full range of M&S food online, but it’s also the home to the widest online supermarket range in the UK and a champion of small, independent brands. We’re also the brains behind Zoom by Ocado, our same-day grocery delivery service.

About the team and the role
Join us as Chief of Staff, working directly for the CEO, where you'll collaborate closely with our CEO and executive team, helping to define strategy, foster culture, and improve how we operate from high-level thinking to daily execution.
You aim to help define, clarify, and communicate the company’s strategic direction; support the team to build a great culture across the business and with our partners; and assist the CEO on many day-to-day tasks, from Board and governance preparation, external and internal comms, and anything and everything else in between! You will be someone who is capable of high-level thinking as well as happy to get your sleeves rolled up and get stuck in. You will be a great communicator and comfortable in debating and challenging the CEO and broader leadership team.

What you’ll do

- 
Lead the formation of the business strategy alongside the CEO, create the strategic narrative, support the leadership team in cascading the strategy throughout the organisation, and ensure continued engagement with the strategy
- 
Prepare the CEO’s regular Board papers to the Ocado Retail, Ocado Group and M&S Boards on trading performance, progress against key objectives, and future plans
- 
Plan and run the annual Board strategy day to ensure the Ocado Retail Board has a clear view of the state of the market and the business’ strategic direction;
- 
Design, plan and facilitate leadership away days for the executive team and wider senior leadership group, and run monthly leadership team lunches
- 
Oversee updates to the business’ five-year plan, in close collaboration with Finance
- 
Run the company-wide Objectives process, including setting new objectives three times a year and providing monthly updates to the executive team
- 
Support driving change and transformation across the business, ensuring that everyone is clear on priorities across different departments
- 
Own the agenda for executive team meetings, ensuring relevant and strategic topics from across the business are discussed at appropriate times
- 
Prepare briefings, scripts and presentation materials for the Executive team’s engagements with equity analysts and the media (e.g. results announcements), suppliers (e.g. conferences), and colleagues (e.g. town halls, huddles, Slack messages)
- 
Act as a sounding board for members of the executive team (e.g. CEO, CFO) and bring external perspectives from other companies, industries and countries
- 
Work with the internal comms team to design the annual colleague engagement plan and support with key engagement moments throughout the year
- 
Work with the EA to the CEO and CFO to ensure meetings and events are scheduled in line with the annual cadence and are run as effectively as possible
- 
Provide ad-hoc strategic support, problem-solving, analysis, and being a general sounding board for the CEO and leadership team.

Who you are

- 
Experienced in strategy roles within a retailer, technology company or management consultancy
- 
Proven track record of influencing and collaborating with senior stakeholders across multiple functions, helping leaders see beyond their own areas
- 
Strong understanding of retail, operational performance metrics and financial accounts
- 
Comfortable working as an independent operator with very senior stakeholders, including at executive level
- 
Experience working in or with fast-growing/scaling businesses is desirable
Key Skills

- 
You apply a structured approach to strategic problems and can switch between the big picture and the detail and judge which one a situation needs
- 
You are an excellent communicator, especially in writing, and can turn complex information into clear, concise stories for audiences from the Board to colleagues
- 
You have experience with commercial modelling and business case development, and are comfortable working with financial metrics
- 
You build trust quickly, listen well, and are comfortable influencing and respectfully challenging senior leaders to create strong alignment
- 
You are proactive and completely reliable: you take the initiative, follow through, with great time keeping skills
- 
You are flexible and thrive on pace and ambiguity, happy to be thrown into anything and to get stuck in
- 
You are very curious about AI, use multiple different AI tools every day, run and manage your own agentic workflows, and are constantly experimenting and looking for better ways of doing things with AI
- 
You handle confidential and sensitive information with complete discretion
- 
Most importantly, you demonstrate our core values:

- 
Always be Curious: ask why and keep on learning
- 
Bring our Best Selves: take ownership and deliver together
- 
Challenge What’s Possible: raise the bar and never give up

What’s in it for you
By joining Ocado Retail, you’ll have the chance to experience life at the world’s largest online retailer, work with an amazing bunch of people who challenge what’s possible each day, and grow your skills and career in online retail.
If that’s not enough to tempt you, you’ll also get access to loads of great benefits to sweeten the deal. Here’s a taste of what we offer:
Health & Wellbeing: Private medical insurance with the option to add your family, Digital GP appointments, market-leading family policies, mental health support, discounted gym memberships, dental insurance, and more.
Spend & Save: Annual bonus scheme split between personal and business objectives, recognition with reward platform, up to 7% matched pension contributions, 15% Ocado discount, 20% M&S discount, free breakfast every day in the office, electric vehicle leasing scheme, and free shuttle bus from Hatfield station to the office.
Never miss the moments that matter: Hybrid working, 26 days holiday plus 8 flexible bank holidays, options to buy extra holiday, 2 weeks work from anywhere, and lifestyle break opportunities.

Our Hiring Process
Lucky for us, we receive a high volume of applications and genuinely appreciate the time and effort invested by every candidate. To ensure a fair and thorough process, every application is reviewed by a member of our team. If your skills and experience are a strong match, a Talent Partner will contact you to discuss the role and guide you through the next steps of our hiring process.
Your Application and AI
In the spirit of innovation, we welcome you to use AI tools in your application, just as we use them in our own business at Ocado Retail. However, as you leverage this technology, please don't lose sight of the most important element: your unique self. Your experiences, passions, and personality are what truly set you apart. Ensure that your application still authentically conveys who you are and why you're a great fit for us.
Everyone’s welcome
We’re an equal opportunities employer, which means that we make sure all potential colleagues are treated fairly and equally. We want to ensure everyone has a fair chance to apply; if you need this job description in an alternative format (e.g., larger print, different document type, etc.), please reach out to us at careers@ocadoretail.com and we'll be happy to assist you, and if you require reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know on the application form.

About us

We’re also the brains behind Zoom by Ocado, our same-day grocery delivery service.

About the team and the role
Strategic Partnerships sits in the broader Partnerships & Commercial Strategy team, within the Commercial Development function. The purpose of Strategic Partnerships is to govern high-value commercial alliances with third parties that bring something new and different to Ocado Retail’s offering, helping us deliver unbeatable choice to customers. The partnerships we support range from M&S to our small challenger brands community (Roots), Buy Women Built, Future of Food and many others.
The team's mandate spans onboarding and hyper-caring new partnerships, embedding more established strategic partnerships into the broader buying function, and running our unique communities on an ongoing basis. We are the central point of contact for M&S where we act as the bridge between teams, helping set joint objectives and surfacing opportunities for growth/cost savings. We also govern certain processes (e.g. M&S range maintenance on Ocado) and report against progress and performance.

The role of the Commercial Partnerships Project Manager is to own the end-to-end delivery of distinct projects within Strategic Partnerships, across the full suite of partnerships. Examples include leading the joint sourcing programme within M&S to unlock COGS efficiencies, running commercial reviews of existing partnerships to identify improvements, and establishing new strategic partnerships that further reinforce our choice proposition.

What you’ll do

- 
Project delivery: scoping the opportunity, defining joint objectives, delivering tasks, and reviewing success
- 
Governance and facilitation: assembling cross-functional project teams across Ocado and the partner, leading regular meetings with project teams, running steercos with senior leadership, creating standardised documentation and tracking against progress
- 
Commercial analysis: using various data sources to provide recommendations, support negotiations and identify opportunities within partnerships
- 
Customer activation: working with our marketing and e-commerce functions to create strong channel execution plans for our partners
- 
Communication and training: creating and evolving playbooks and toolkits to coordinate, support and educate other teams and ensure consistency of approach

Who you are
What you bring (essential):

- 
Experience running multi-stakeholder projects end to end, from scoping and planning through to delivery and review
- 
A background in retail, FMCG, food supply chain, or a buying, sourcing or commercial function
- 
Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and experience turning large or messy data sets into clear recommendations
- 
A working knowledge of AI tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude, Copilot) and experience in using them to speed up analysis, documentation, and repeatable processes
- 
Clear written and verbal communication, including presenting to executives
Nice to have (desirable)

- 
Experience in commercial negotiations or tendering
- 
Familiarity with retail data tools
- 
Experience building playbooks, toolkits or repeatable processes
- 
Experience in partnerships, joint ventures or alliance management

How you work:

- 
Collaborative: comfortable building relationships across a broad range of stakeholders and levels of seniority, including senior contacts at M&S and other partners, and internal buying, customer, finance and legal teams, so that joint projects get delivered.
- 
Structured: takes a structured approach to new projects and prioritises across a breadth of tasks, so that several projects of different sizes can run in parallel across different partnerships.
- 
Analytical: naturally data-led and curious, comfortable pulling disparate data into a clear conclusion, so that recommendations are evidence-based and can support negotiations and show where a partnership is under- or over-delivering.
- 
Commercial: has working knowledge of commercial negotiations and what drives commercial performance, so that projects deliver tangible outcomes such as COGS savings.

Commercial Planning & Client Ownership

- 
Drive and generate advertising revenue through a consultative sales approach, through strategic delivery of media and data within commercial terms and unlocking incremental revenue streams.
- 
Pitch and generate revenue of the Beet Insights platform, through consultative selling.
- 
Business partner with commercial teams to ensure supplier media plans are delivering defined commercial outcomes and strong campaign performance.
- 
Hold accountability and management of the retail media investment and revenue targets for the supplier portfolio under your remit.
- 
Advise and guide suppliers to create strong media plans that help deliver against brand, Ocado, and Customer objectives, across the Ocado Ads portfolio.
- 
Be able to pitch compelling, customer-first media plans that are linked to the suppliers’ strategic goals, across the full Ocodo Ads portfolio, on and offsite.

Strategic Leadership & Team Management

- 
Lead and manage a highly engaged, high-performing Media Partner across media planning, Beet usage, supplier relationship management, and internal stakeholder alignment.
- 
Foster a new team of Retail Media Managers and Media Partners as the department grows, providing coaching and development as they become industry experts.
- 
Be responsible for building out a new operating model for media planning, working alongside buyers to integrate media strategy seamlessly.

Data, Insights & Cross-Channel Expertise

- 
Own reporting of media utilisation and performance (Onsite, Offsite, Beet and overall ROI) to inform future media plans and propositions.
- 
Use sophisticated analytical skills (primarily via Beet) to simplify the complex, demonstrating the value of media investments to diverse internal and external audiences.
- 
Oversee the strategy and execution of media plans across all channels, including onsite, offsite, and other evolving media formats.
- 
Identify larger opportunities (ie. events) and recognise the bigger picture and connect with the wider organisation, translating high-level strategy into simple, executable plans.

Who you are

- 
Strong team management and proven leadership credentials, with experience building or mentoring a high-performing team.
- 
Highly analytical and commercially astute individual, with direct experience managing a P&L or revenue targets.
- 
Extensive experience working with retail media plans, FMCG brands, and/or media agencies.
- 
Have strong customer relationship management skills, with a proven track record of building trusted, long-term relationships with senior stakeholders.
- 
Comfortable with sales, negotiation, and presenting complex data-driven proposals.
- 
A credible individual who can project trust and lead with authority across various seniority levels.
- 
Strong passion for the development of our new retail media network and being a pivotal part of a major transformation roadmap.
- 
Ability to navigate the complex, embrace ambiguity, and maintain momentum in a fast-paced environment.
- 
Calm under pressure; detail-oriented; pragmatic; self-aware and resilient.

What’s in it for you
By joining Ocado Retail, you’ll have the chance to experience life at the world’s largest online retailer, work with an amazing bunch of people who challenge what’s possible each day, and grow your skills and career in online retail. You'll also be part of our AI Academy, a dedicated learning journey designed to empower every colleague with the smart technology skills of the future.
If that’s not enough to tempt you, you’ll also get access to loads of great benefits to sweeten the deal. Here’s a taste of what we offer:
Health & Wellbeing: Private medical insurance with option to add your family, Digital GP appointments, market-leading family policies, mental health support, discounted gym memberships, dental insurance, and more.
Spend & Save: Annual bonus scheme split between personal and business objectives, recognition with reward platform, up to 7% matched pension contributions, 15% Ocado discount, 20% M&S discount, free breakfast every day in the office, electric vehicle leasing scheme, and free shuttle bus from Hatfield station to the office.
Never miss the moments that matter: Hybrid working, 26 days holiday plus 8 flexible bank holidays, options to buy extra holiday, 2 weeks work from anywhere, and lifestyle break opportunities.

Our Hiring Process
Lucky for us, we receive a high volume of applications and genuinely appreciate the time and effort invested by every candidate. To ensure a fair and thorough process, every application is reviewed by a member of our team. If your skills and experience are a strong match, a Talent Partner will contact you to discuss the role and guide you through the next steps of our hiring process.
Your Application and AI
In the spirit of innovation, we welcome you to use AI tools in your application, just as we use them in our own business at Ocado Retail. However, as you leverage this technology, please don't lose sight of the most important element: your unique self. Your experiences, passions, and personality are what truly set you apart. Ensure that your application still authentically conveys who you are and why you're a great fit for us.
Everyone’s welcome
We’re an equal opportunities employer, which means that we make sure all potential colleagues are treated fairly and equally. We want to ensure everyone has a fair chance to apply; if you need this job description in an alternative format (e.g., larger print, different document type, etc.), please reach out to us at careers@ocadoretail.com and we'll be happy to assist you, and if you require reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know on the application form.

Growth Accounts and Agency Lead
Contract type: Permanent
Location: Hatfield (Hybrid working - 2 days in our Hatfield office and 1 day working with agencies in London)
Working hours per week: 40 hours
Level: Lead

About us
Our mission is to deliver joy in every shop, through unbeatable choice, unrivalled service, and reassuringly good value.
We’re Ocado Retail, a market-leading joint venture between Ocado Group and M&S, and the world’s largest dedicated online supermarket, ocado.com. Not only is Ocado.com the only place to shop a full range of M&S food online, it’s also the home to the widest online supermarket range in the UK and champion of small, independent brands. We’re also the brains behind Zoom by Ocado, our same-day grocery delivery service.

About the team and the role

Your role covers selling the full Ocado Ads portfolio, including the Beet proprietary data and insights platform, to our CPG partners.
You will be a commercial leader with a deep understanding of retail media, digital advertising, and the grocery landscape.

-

-

-

Identify and convert opportunities for upselling and cross-selling the full suite of Ocado Ads products, including sponsored search, programmatic display, and innovative custom solutions.

Educate and enable the wider Ocado Ads team to lead account level agency discussions to drive incremental revenue.

-

-

Experience in a leadership/senior commercial role.
- 
Proven track record of consistently exceeding large sales quotas and driving significant revenue growth.

Deep expertise in Retail Media, eCommerce, or programmatic advertising, with an understanding of the grocery sector a strong plus.
- 
Exceptional ability to build rapport, influence, and negotiate at the senior executive level, both with clients and agencies.
- 
Strong analytical skills, capable of using data and insights to create compelling commercial narratives.
- 
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
-
